headline: Recommended approval, with a modification limiting front yard opaque fence height, of citywide Zone Change #3264; two liquor license requests withdrawn.
summary: The meeting held a public hearing on Zone Change #3264, which amends Article 7, Section 7.4.223(A) citywide. Two people spoke in favor and none spoke against. Members voted 6-0 to recommend approval with a modification, and two liquor license requests were withdrawn.
decisions: Withdrawn: beer and wine package store liquor license request for 500 Page Boulevard (Page Convenience), vote 6-0.
Withdrawn: all alcoholic liquor license (new) request for 211 Worthington Street (La Mesa Serena Restaurant), vote 6-0.
Recommended approval, with a modification, of Zone Change #3264 amending Article 7, Section 7.4.223(A) citywide, vote 6-0.

PUBLIC HEARING : (NEW )  
 
Zone Change 
 
1. Zone Change #3264 
Address: City Wide  
Amending Article 7, Section 7.4.223(A)  
Petitioner: Springfield City Council  
 
SPEAKING IN FAVOR: TWO (2)  
SPEAKING AGAINST: ZERO (0)  
 
MOTION: Approve, with a modification.  
Proposed Modification by adding the following language: 
 
“In the case of front yard fencing, no opaque fence shall be higher than three (3) feet. 
A fence more than twenty-five (25) percent solid is considered to be opaque.”  
 
IN FAVOR: six (6): Ms. Morin, Mr. Daniele, Ms. McQuade, Mr. Cunningham, Mr. Milette 
and Ms. Ford 
OPPOSED: zero (0)  
ABSTAINED:  N/A
